raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Reduce Python overhead in KVCR pin acquisition, transfer descriptor construction, and completion handling. Builds on #60469.

## Claims

- Avoid redundant key-set checks and key conversions during pin acquisition.
- Convert NumPy chunk IDs to Python integers in bulk and cache the NIXL agent name used by descriptors.
- Skip unused successful-key accumulation on fully successful completion while preserving partial-failure reporting.

## Validation

Extended tests added in `tests/v1/kv_offload/tiering/test_kvcr_tier.py` cover reordered and invalid pin jobs, Python-integer descriptors, and successful and partially failed transfers.

AI-assisted implementation.

nodes.body:
Some details of perf improvements:

**Full framework-pin acquisition:** CPU-only metadata benchmark comparing #60469 (`e366c763`) with #63889 (`121aa10e`), keeping KVCR at `7186e7c2`. Values are lower medians of ten acquisitions after three warmups, with stage/function profiling disabled; R1/R2 are separate repeats.

| Blocks | #60469, ms (R1 / R2) | #63889, ms (R1 / R2) | Time reduction (R1 / R2) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1,024 | 3.54 / 3.42 | 3.22 / 3.24 | **9.0% / 5.3%** |
| 32,768 | 141.16 / 141.87 | 134.28 / 132.44 | **4.9% / 6.6%** |
| 262,144 | 1,630.60 / 1,635.28 | 1,576.29 / 1,565.58 | **3.3% / 4.3%** |
| 524,288 | 3,936.65 / 3,961.88 | 3,803.92 / 3,770.41 | **3.4% / 4.8%** |

**Preparation stages targeted by the PR:** job validation, descriptor-map allocation, and descriptor construction combined. Values are means of ten acquisitions from separate stage-instrumented passes, including GC time within those stages.

| Blocks | #60469, ms (R1 / R2) | #63889, ms (R1 / R2) | Time reduction (R1 / R2) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1,024 | 0.493 / 0.504 | 0.236 / 0.222 | **52.1% / 56.0%** |
| 32,768 | 24.00 / 24.27 | 14.08 / 13.93 | **41.3% / 42.6%** |
| 262,144 | 302.21 / 300.34 | 219.91 / 220.84 | **27.2% / 26.5%** |
| 524,288 | 729.90 / 716.67 | 547.10 / 539.01 | **25.0% / 24.8%** |

**Individual preparation stages at 524,288 blocks:** the same instrumented measurements broken down by operation. Some conversion work moved from validation into construction, so the combined row is the fairest comparison.

| Stage | #60469, ms (R1 / R2) | #63889, ms (R1 / R2) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Job materialization / validation | 89.682 / 87.685 | 0.003 / 0.002 |
| Descriptor-map allocation | 76.85 / 79.46 | 37.01 / 35.65 |
| Descriptor construction | 563.37 / 549.52 | 510.09 / 503.36 |
| **Combined** | **729.90 / 716.67** | **547.10 / 539.01** |

All correctness and release checks passed. These measurements cover metadata acquisition; GPU transfers and end-to-end inference were not measured.
